record.paper_title: Initial boundary value problem for Korteweg-de Vries equation: a review and open problems
record.context_brief: Low-regularity well-posedness threshold for finite-interval KdV IBVP
record.original_question: For the same finite-interval Korteweg-de Vries initial-boundary value problem u_t + u_x + u_{xxx} + u u_x = 0 with initial data u(x,0)=φ(x) and general boundary conditions B_k u = h on 0 < x < L, determine whether the problem is well-posed in H^s(0,L) for some regularity level s ≤ -1. The paper states that local well-posedness is known for s ≥ 0 and can be extended to -1 < s ≤ 0, but the regime s ≤ -1 remains unresolved, with the authors conjecturing ill-posedness for every s < -1.

evidence.quote: • Is the IBVP well-posed in the space H s (0, L) for some s ≤ −1?
Theorem G ensures that the IBVP (4.18) is locally well-posed in the space H s (0, L) for any s ≥ 0. Theorem G can also be extended to the case of −1 < s ≤ 0 using the same approach developed in [8].
We conjecture that the IBVP (4.18) is ill-posed in the space H s (0, L) for any s < −1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the Korteweg–de Vries equation on the finite interval (0,L) with t>0:
  u_t + u_x + u_{xxx} + u u_x = 0,  0<x<L,  t>0,
together with the initial condition
  u(x,0) = φ(x),  0<x<L,
and a set of three linear boundary conditions of the form
  B_k u(t) = h_k(t),  k=1,2,3,  t>0,
where each B_k is a linear combination of the boundary traces u(0,t), u(L,t), u_x(0,t), u_x(L,t), u_{xx}(0,t), u_{xx}(L,t) chosen so that the linearized problem is well-posed.

For s∈ℝ, say the initial-boundary value problem is locally well-posed in H^s(0,L) if, for every (φ, h_1, h_2, h_3) in the natural product of H^s(0,L) and the corresponding compatible boundary trace spaces, there exist a time T>0 and a unique solution u∈C([0,T];H^s(0,L)) depending continuously on the data.

It is known that local well-posedness holds in H^s(0,L) for every s>-1.

Question: Does there exist any s ≤ -1 for which the above initial-boundary value problem is locally well-posed in H^s(0,L)? In particular, is the problem ill-posed in H^s(0,L) for every s<-1?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not turn up any subsequent work establishing well-posedness or ill-posedness for the KdV IBVP on a finite interval in H^s(0,L) with s ≤ -1. Known results only extend local well-posedness down to s > -1 (and earlier to s > -3/4), and the conjectured ill-posedness for s < -1 does not appear to have been proved. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The Initial-Boundary Value Problem for the Korteweg–de Vries Equation
status_evidence.snippet: Local well-posedness of the KdV IBVP on a half-line and finite interval is established for Sobolev regularities s > -3/4.
status_evidence.claim: Best known low-regularity well-posedness for the KdV IBVP reaches s>-3/4, well above s=-1.

status_evidence.title: General boundary value problems of the Korteweg–de Vries equation on a bounded domain
status_evidence.snippet: Local well-posedness in H^s(0,L) for s ≥ 0 under general linear boundary conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Standard reference establishes well-posedness for s ≥ 0, with extensions to negative s but not down to s ≤ -1.
